summary: To finalize the structural corrosion treatment strategy for the Uppercamp project before office construction commences, and to advance the conceptual design of the new roof support system to allow for architectural, HVAC, and electrical coordination.

keyRisks.impact: Requires proactive oversight to maintain timeline.
Delays in securing a corrosion treatment vendor could overlap with the start of upper camp office construction.
keyRisks.mitigation: Expedite alternative quotes (Zipex, Spray Lock) and establish methodology ASAP.

keyRisks.impact: The combined cost of corrosion treatment and the new roof structure might exceed the approved project budget.
keyRisks.mitigation: Submit concept quantities to the QS for a preliminary estimate before proceeding to detailed design.

criticalDecisions: : Demolition will precede the corrosion protection treatment to ensure proper surface bonding and minimize dust interference.
: The structural loading requirement for the new accessible roof is established at 3 kN per square meter.
: The conceptual roof design will proceed using a Bond Deck system over a steel frame (web angles and I-sections), avoiding internal columns where possible.

wayForward.task: Finalize technical scope and issue updated project plan
